building_blocks.name: Self-Growth Engine
building_blocks.note: Audit and design complete 2026-11-15: recursive research loop on existing machinery, privacy triage fork, corroboration gate, shadow-only births; skill operational layer plus skill-consult; learning law distillation added by owner 2026-11-15 22:08 PT. Builds are chain item 10, scenes S1 to S4.

building_blocks.name: Training Refresh (Kaggle cadence)
building_blocks.note: Criteria-driven: fires at 50 or more new facts or 7 days elapsed; daily check 04:15 PT verified armed 2026-11-15; about 0.18 GPU-hours used that week against a 10 GPU-hour weekly cap. Next expected fire 2026-11-23.

building_blocks.name: Sync and Publish (event tunnel)
building_blocks.note: Event-driven box to Tailscale Funnel to Vercel; page names its own mode (LIVE, FALLBACK, BAKED); FALLBACK now equals LIVE. Actions budget $5 set by owner; burn cuts landed as chain item 0.

building_blocks.name: Governance and Safety
building_blocks.note: Data stays on the box; system-only handover is the owner's call alone; never-do list held; hourly backups kept; semantic-prod never delete. Open: security gate re-enable before go-live, deadline 2026-11-20.
